economicEquation.clearedContributionUsd: clearedPayments - refunds - disputes - paymentFees - mailboxAndSequencerCost - researchAndVerificationCost - modelAndBrowserCost - deliveryProviderCost - supportLaborCost - founderMinuteCost
economicEquation.breakEvenSales: ceil((all fixed and variable costs excluding delivery-variable-per-sale) / (clearedPricePerSale - paymentFeesPerSale - deliveryVariableCostPerSale - supportVariableCostPerSale))
economicEquation.rule: If any required term is unknown, the economic result is UNKNOWN rather than zero.

rules: The stricter current UberBond complaint threshold wins.
Any suppression, provenance, provider-policy, DNS, authentication, or uncertain-provider-outcome failure pauses before volume math matters.
Never buy contacts or infer private addresses.
Canada and Australia remain disabled without qualified consent evidence; other jurisdictions require exact adjudication.
Do not scale from replies, opens, meetings, or model scores; require cleared payment, accepted delivery, measured costs, and founder minutes.
